items.title: Louis Gallaud Interview, 1960-03-18
items.q: But we used to play in the same place. At the same time. Same job.

ctx.x: But we used to play in the same place. At the same time. Same job. Yeah, when we wouldn't be there, you know, he used to play. And he used to be a waiter. He was a first class waiter. Do you know where he came from?
Anything about him? I don't know anything about him.
